# Included dependency

`qrcodegen.py`: Project Nayuki QR Code generator v1.8.0, MIT license retained
in the source header. Source commit `720f62bddb7226106071d4728c292cb1df519ceb`.
https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/blob/720f62bddb7226106071d4728c292cb1df519ceb/python/qrcodegen.py

Used only to generate the local help address as a QR code. No runtime download,
third-party endpoint or extra installation required.
